spans.s: शच् vt. 1Ā (pres. शंचते in the first sense; शचते in the second) 1. To go, to move; 2. to speak, to say, to tell.
शची(चि) f. Name of the wife of Indra, R.iii.13, 23.

सचि (I) m. 1. A friend; 2. friendship.

सची f. The same as शची q.v.

सचेष्ट m. The mango tree.

सच्चारा f. turmeric.
सच्चिद् n. the supreme spirit.
सच्चिद्˚अंश m. a portion of existence and thought.
सच्चिद्˚आत्मन् m. the soul which consists of entity and thought.
